shared: Create a NEW TownGrid production sprite atlas using the provided sawmill ICON ONLY AS A STYLE REFERENCE, not as the building subject. Match its crisp hand-clustered pixel art, honey timber, dark teal fine outlines, teal tiled roofs, warm cream trim and upper-left lighting. Same fantasy-industrial village world. Real visible pixel clusters, NOT smooth vector, NOT plastic 3D render. EXACT 4 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS of equal square cells, square image. True transparent background; no text, no labels, no grid lines, no people, no watermarks. Each cell contains a complete single tile-sized game object with 12% clear padding on ALL sides. Bottom ground baseline at 86% of EACH CELL; NEVER allow any sprite into neighboring cells. Perfectly consistent size, anchor, fixed 35-degree downward isometric camera across every cell. FOUR CAMERA VIEWS: row1 SE (front+right), row2 NE (right+back), row3 NW (back+left), row4 SW (left+front), exactly 90 degrees apart. Draw actual different facades, not a facade always facing the camera. Each row is an animation/state strip: architecture and silhouette stay stable across its four columns. No thick floating landscape island, only a thin footprint.

subjects.warehouse: SUBJECT: a village WAREHOUSE clearly recognizable by its broad tall double freight doors, stacked wooden shipping crates and grain sacks, tiny timber loading platform. Compact wider rectangular timber building, dark teal tiled gable roof, no domestic chimney or flower garden. Freight door on the south/front wall; crate pile to its west, sacks to its east. Back wall mostly closed with narrow slatted high vent. Columns: 1 large double cargo doors closed, 2 doors partly opening, 3 doors fully open revealing orderly crates inside, 4 doors partly closing. In rear views show unchanged rear wall, not fake doors on every side. Keep external crates consistent, do not add/remove cargo arbitrarily. Open-door states show cargo handling readiness. Four useful views with distinct front/back and sided loading props.
subjects.house: SUBJECT: a small cozy resident COTTAGE. Warm cream plaster between honey timber beams, teal tiled gable roof with a tiny attic dormer, single wooden front door and two glowing amber windows. Small flower pot beside door, firewood by the side. ONE stone chimney at rear-east roof corner; keep it physically in same place for all camera views. Distinctly a modest family home, NOT shop/warehouse/workshop. Columns: 1 no chimney smoke, quiet closed cottage; 2 small pale grey pixel puff close to chimney; 3 two small puffs rising slightly higher; 4 upper puff dissolves into several crisp pixels. Roof, walls, windows and door NEVER move. Keep smoke inside margins and use only tiny discreet puffs, not huge clouds. Four actual architectural sides with front door visible only from front two views.
subjects.well: SUBJECT: a recognizable old village WATER WELL. Short circular ring of pale weathered stone, dark turquoise open water at center, TWO stout oak posts, small teal gabled canopy above, a timber spool with rope and a metal-banded wooden bucket, little side crank. Open structure with view through it, no walls or hut. Stone rim, turquoise water and hanging bucket clearly readable. A second stationary filled bucket on ground to one side identifies water output. Columns: 1 idle bucket parked on rim, 2 working rope long with bucket lowered into well, 3 bucket halfway up with rope visibly shorter, 4 filled bucket at rim pouring a small crisp turquoise splash into waiting pail. Keep ring/post/roof identical, only spool/crank angle, rope length, bucket and drops change. Four camera views; front rim occludes lowered bucket correctly.
subjects.lumber: SUBJECT: an unmistakable compact village LOGGING CAMP. Open low timber log rack with bark-covered stacked round logs, prominent chopping stump with an axe resting in it, a small wooden A-frame log-lifting derrick with rope, hand winch and an attached horizontal fresh log. Tiny teal slanted rain cover over the stacked logs at rear only. Lots of clearly round log ends and bark, NO circular saw (that belongs to separate sawmill), no finished boards, no workers/people or disembodied moving axe. Columns: 1 suspended log resting low on support with rope slack, 2 winch raises it a small amount and rope taut, 3 log lifted to rack height, 4 log lowered toward log stack, different crank angle. Stable building structure across all frames; only the attached rope/crane log winch moves. Four actual camera views with stump and derrick attached to consistent world corners, not magically facing forward.
subjects.field: SUBJECT: one WHEAT FARM PLOT (no building). A thin diamond-shaped square patch of warm brown tilled soil, 4 tidy parallel furrow rows, tiny stone irrigation channel on its north/back edge and a small wooden water tub fixed at its northeast corner. No grass island, no fence or roof. Four columns are GROWTH STAGES: 1 freshly tilled bare moist rows with tiny planted seeds, 2 many evenly spaced short light-green sprouts, 3 taller green wheat stems with immature ears, 4 rich golden ripe wheat with large readable grain heads and a few leaves, obviously ready to harvest. Same soil outline/irrigation channel/tub positions and same physical ground size in every frame, only plants grow. Four rows are the same plot rotated in 90-degree camera increments, so irrigation channel and tub must move around the image logically. Keep footprint as correct isometric diamond and include full crop plants without cropping. Golden mature wheat like pixel farming RPG art, not smooth 3D cartoon.
